extends: "admin/_admin_base.html" if is_admin else "official/_official_base.html" if is_official else "resident/_portal_base.html"
'admin/_admin_base.html' if is_admin else ('official/_official_base.html' if is_official else 'resident/_portal_base.html')

findings: Three portal layouts and one public/auth layout have conflicting final CSS layers.
Resident portal does not load Bootstrap although profile forms need Bootstrap.
Profile image page has no information tabs or role-specific edit forms.
Resident header renders initials even when a profile photo exists.
Profile uploads decode and re-encode safely but support JPEG/PNG only.
Official/admin photo and resident photo references can diverge after staff replacements.
Navigation lacks desktop compact mode and a persistent theme switcher.
Original A4 templates must be isolated from global frontend styles.
